column3: what
plain C cannot stop cse folding or substituting a constant/absolute address the target keeps base-relative or in its own reg
plain C cannot stop cse (or cse2) folding a constant or joined expression the target computes
plain C cannot stop cse merging, canonicalising or forwarding a reg copy the target keeps in its own reg
plain C cannot stop cse forwarding a stored or loaded value (or caching a global load) the target reloads
plain C cannot stop combine merging or sinking a (arg) copy the target keeps
plain C cannot fix the operand order combine picks for a commutative op
plain C cannot keep an arg copy where the target has it; sched1 or reload_cse hoists/sinks it across the call setup
plain C cannot undo sched1's birthing-insn priority boost against a local-alloc constant
plain C cannot set the order sched1 gives independent insns (births, ready-list ties, load pairs, call groups)
plain C cannot stop sched1 hoisting or sinking one insn (return value, constant pair, la/lui, load, store) past the target slot
plain C cannot stop the scheduler filling a load-delay slot the target leaves as nop
plain C cannot change sched2's function-unit hazard or blockage ordering
plain C cannot steer which insn delayed-branch fill puts in (or keeps out of) a delay slot
plain C cannot change local-alloc qty priority or tie order (refs, live length, $v0 first), so the hard reg goes to the other pseudo
plain C cannot break a local-alloc copy preference or tie (dying base, dying pin, call result, hard-reg copy)
plain C cannot clear a hard-reg conflict, live-to-end or dead-reuse that blocks the target pairing
plain C cannot change global-alloc priority order (refs, nrefs, bank order, LO_REG count), so hard regs land in another order
plain C cannot break a global-alloc copy or expand preference that picks the wrong hard reg
lever-free, the temps take the hard reg the pin's pseudo reserves for the whole function
callee-saved order follows only from a return-type/signature change across shared callers (signature lane, not a body edit)
plain C cannot change reload's reg choice, rematerialisation or second base across a call
plain C cannot stop loop.c adding, combining or rebasing induction variables the target keeps as-is
plain C cannot stop loop.c hoisting a loop-invariant constant the target loads in the loop
plain C cannot stop jump2 cross-jumping byte-identical arms or a fall-through store
plain C cannot keep a redundant test on a known value; flow or jump threading folds it
flow deletes a result or store the target computes but never uses
plain C cannot keep live the value a void-return expansion drops
plain C cannot make expand recompute a return-value reg live from entry
the crack needs a shared-header prototype change, outside a body edit
the instruction has no C form in gcc 2.7.2 (addu/mfc2/... spelled only as an asm macro)
a hand-placed $sp write (stack switch) has no C spelling
a hand-written body or prelude (fixed reg roles, hand-filled slots) that gcc does not emit
plain C cannot keep a dead chain (loads/adds into a never-used reg) the target keeps; jump after-regscan and cse delete_dead_from_cse drop it before flow
a hard-reg pinned var expands to RTL no pseudo spelling gives (one insn on the hard reg vs temp+copy; a direct read of incoming $aN) and the gap never closes before sched1
lever-free, combine folds the var away and its dead pseudo gets a stack slot, not a hard reg; insns equal, frame size differs
